summary: Industrial chic. This cool, sophisticated grey polish offers a sleek, modern alternative to traditional neutrals for an effortlessly edgy manicure.
technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 15ml, this KoColor POLISH is expertly formulated with Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Titanium Dioxide, Black 2. Delivering a high-fidelity Concrete Slate color profile (`#708090`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
